selection_rule: Minimise equal-weight age/postcode normalised domain-span loss over all source rows, before suppression; subject to k/l validity, non-empty release, and <=10% overall suppression. Tie-break by lower suppression, then age level, then postcode level.
postcode_semantics: Fictional four-digit tokens. Prefixes define a synthetic hierarchy only; no Australian locality, delivery area, or geographic relationship is claimed.
generation_interpretation: Researcher-defined simulation assumptions, not observed UTS or Canvas student characteristics. A synthetic unobserved study-context variable creates controlled associations; postcode does not cause academic performance. No realised outcomes used for parameter tuning.
